requirements.name: pad-number
requirements.message:
Every `board_pad` prim MUST carry `pcba:board:padNumber` — the pad's own designation within its
footprint — present **even on an unoccupied pad**. On an occupied pad it should equal that
pad's `pcba:board:componentPinNumber`.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 6 and 10.

requirements.name: paste-side
requirements.message:
When solder paste geometry is supplied, the side of each `board_paste` deposit MUST be
determinable: either `pcba:board:solderLayer` (`top` \| `bottom`) is authored on the deposit,
or it derives from a containing layer prim's `pcba:layer:side`.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 10 and 11.1.

requirements.name: board-thickness
requirements.message:
The board-root prim MUST carry `pcba:board:thicknessMm`, the real **pressed** (post-lamination)
board thickness in millimetres, and the `board_substrate` mesh MUST be a solid slab of that
thickness — a zero-thickness plane is invalid.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 5 and 11.

requirements.name: paste-association
requirements.message:
When solder paste geometry is supplied, each `board_paste` deposit MUST name the contact it
serves with the same pair a pad or barrel uses: `pcba:board:refdes` +
`pcba:board:componentPinNumber`. The `pcba:board:pasteFor` relationship is a SHOULD — a direct
handle when the component prim is in the file — not the association itself.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 6 and 10.

requirements.name: hole-and-pad-geometry
requirements.message:
Every `board_barrel` MUST describe its plated-through-hole geometry — `pcba:board:holeCenterMm`,
`pcba:board:holeShape`, `pcba:board:holeDimsMm` — **or** author one of the two derivable forms
the contract allows (a drill radius for a round hole; shape + dims + the contour mesh for a
slot). `pcba:board:padContour` on a `board_pad` is a SHOULD: the pad mesh itself is the
authoritative exposed-pad extent.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 6 and 10. The carrier of
hole data is the `board_barrel`, not `board_hole`; there is no `holeSide` attribute.

requirements.name: hole-occupancy
requirements.message:
Every `board_pad` and `board_barrel` MUST declare `pcba:board:occupied`, or declare
that occupancy is unresolved using the provenance convention below. An occupied
site names its component terminal with **`pcba:board:refdes` +
`pcba:board:componentPinNumber`**. This applies to SMT pads as well as THT joints.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 6 and 10.
`board_hole` is optional bookkeeping; occupancy and association belong on the
actual pad or barrel. There are no `holeSide` or `plated` fields.

requirements.name: copper-mask-geometry
requirements.message:
The board MUST carry copper-layer geometry and solder-mask geometry with role-consistent
materials: at least one `Mesh` with `pcba:mesh:role = "board_copper"` and at least one with
`pcba:mesh:role = "board_mask"`, so the rendered board has production-accurate colour and finish.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 5 and 9.

requirements.name: hole-plating
requirements.message:
Every plated hole at an **occupied through-hole joint** MUST be backed by a `Mesh` with
`pcba:mesh:role = "board_barrel"` — the copper plating through the board thickness. This
includes `press_fit` parts. The barrel carries the hole data and the board-side association
(`pcba:board:refdes` + `pcba:board:componentPinNumber`) for that joint.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 6 and 10.
There is no `pcba:board:plated` flag; `board_hole` prims are optional bookkeeping.

requirements.name: paste-in-hole
requirements.message:
For through-hole components the paste association MUST be **empty** unless the paste-in-hole
(pin-in-paste / through-hole reflow) process applies. When it does, the deposit is a normal
`board_paste` prim naming its contact with `pcba:board:refdes` + `pcba:board:componentPinNumber`
and carrying its side, exactly like SMT paste.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 10 and 12.
